an4.233:1.6: atthi bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhamasukkaṃ akaṇha-asukkavipākaṃ kammaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati. 2.
an4.233:2.1: Katamañ ca bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ?
an4.233:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco savyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti . . . savyāpajjhaṃ manosaṅkharaṃ abhisaṅkharoti.
an4.233:2.3: So savyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā savyāpajjhaṃ vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā savyāpajjhaṃ manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā savyāpajjhaṃ lokaṃ uppajjati.
an4.233:2.4: Tam enaṃ savyāpajjhaṃ lokaṃ uppannaṃ samānaṃ savyāpajjhā phassā phusanti.
an4.233:2.5: So savyāpajjhehi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno savyāpajjhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyati ekantadukkhaṃ, seyyathāpi sattā nerayikā.
an4.233:2.6: Idam vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākam. 3.
an4.233:3.1: Katamañ ca bhikkhave kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ?
an4.233:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco avyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāroti . . . pe . . . avyāpajjhaṃ manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti.
an4.233:3.3: So avyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā . . . pe . . . manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅharitvā avyāpajjhaṃ lokaṃ uppajjati.
an4.233:3.4: Tam enaṃ avyāpajjhaṃ lokaṃ uppannaṃ samānaṃ avyāpajjhā phassā phusanti.
an4.233:3.5: So avyāpajjhehi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno avyāpajjhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyati ekantasukhaṃ, seyyathāpi devā Subhakiṇhā.
an4.233:3.6: Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ. 4.
an4.233:4.1: Katamañ ca bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ?
an4.233:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco savyāpajjham pi avyāpajjham pi kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti . . . savyāpajjhaṃ pi avyāpajjham pi manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti.
an4.233:4.3: So savyāpajjham pi avyāpajjham pi kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā . . . savyāpajjham pi avyāpajjham pi manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā savyāpajjham pi avyāpajjham pi lokaṃ uppajjati.
an4.233:4.4: Tam enaṃ savyāpajjham pi avyāpajjham pi lokaṃ uppannaṃ samānaṃ savyāpajjhā pi avyāpajjhā pi phassā phusanti.
an4.233:4.5: So savyāpajjhehi pi avyāpajjhehi pi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno savyāpajjham pi avyāpajjham pi vedanaṃ vediyati vokiṇṇaṃ saṅkiṇṇaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ, seyathāpi manussā ekacce ca devā ekacce ca vinipātikā.
an4.233:4.6: Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ. 5.
an4.233:5.1: Katamañ ca bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhamasukkaṃ akaṇha-asukkavipākaṃ kammaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati?
an4.233:5.2: Tatra bhikkhave yam idaṃ kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ tassa pahānāya yā cetanā, yam p' idaṃ kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ tassa pahānāya yā cetanā, yam p' idaṃ kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ tassa pahānāya yā cetanā
an4.233:5.3: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhamasukkaṃ akaṇha-asukkavipākaṃ kammaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.
an4.233:5.4: Imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri kammāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditānīti. 233. 1.
